deck.name: Urban Tarot
deck.creator: Robin Scott
deck.description: The Urban Tarot reclaims the power of old magic for 21st century seekers, finding wonder in the metropolis and the power under the pavement.

majorArcana.name: The Fool
majorArcana.interpretation: The childlike part willing to make a leap, too naive to recognize the impossible, sets out with a glad heart into the unknown.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Person standing on building ledge, symbol on T-shirt references The Zero Movement

majorArcana.name: The Mage
majorArcana.interpretation: Sees the world and makes a choice to act, creates magic through beliefs and connections, the will to create and succeed.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Musician with cup, disk, sword, wand representing four elements

majorArcana.name: The High Priestess
majorArcana.interpretation: Yin to Mage's Yang, creating magic through intuition, drinking from inner font of unconscious. Wu wei - action without action.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Feminine counterpart to the Mage, effortless doing

majorArcana.name: The Empress
majorArcana.interpretation: Symbol of life and creation, Great Mother, Mother Nature, abundant and endless nurturing energy.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Warm tones of late 70's design, antique refrigerator, kitchen setting

majorArcana.name: The Emperor
majorArcana.interpretation: Symbol of authority, guardian of order and stability, protector against chaos and fear.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Mayor of New York standing on East River under Brooklyn Bridge during Hurricane Sandy

majorArcana.name: The Hierophant
majorArcana.interpretation: About community, trusting hierarchy structure, both light and darkness in institutions.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Catholic church symbols - three circles (Trinity), bishop's crook combined with papal staff

majorArcana.name: The Lovers
majorArcana.interpretation: Opposites united and intertwined, melded into one through power of love, harmony of Yin and Yang.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Small wedding ceremony lighting candle together

majorArcana.name: The Chariot
majorArcana.interpretation: About having will, rolling forward never stopping, building something from nothing against all obstacles.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Person crouched on taxi, First Baptist Church of New York in background

majorArcana.name: Justice
majorArcana.theme: What is just, fair, and right
majorArcana.interpretation: Core ideal of society, rule of law, balanced and ethical judgment. Needs guidance of love and mercy.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Blindfolded figure with sword of truth

majorArcana.name: The Hermit
majorArcana.interpretation: Listening to inner voice, illuminating path through darkest places, connected to Moon and darker aspects of psyche.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Accompanied by Cerberus (three-headed hound), symbol of journey into underworld

majorArcana.name: Wheel of Fortune
majorArcana.interpretation: Sudden windfall and unexpected tragedy, neither positive nor negative - reality of living in constantly changing world.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Coney Island Wonder Wheel with Sphinx enthroned, off-season with dark uncertain sky

majorArcana.name: Strength
majorArcana.interpretation: Physical, emotional, determination - the lion fierce and mighty, and the woman who tames it with gentle force and calm.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Wrestling the marble lion 'Fortitude' outside New York Public Library

majorArcana.name: The Hanged Man
majorArcana.interpretation: Moving forward sometimes means giving up, learning sometimes requires unlearning, turning things upside down.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Corporate figure on girder letting worldly wealth fall from pockets

majorArcana.name: Death
majorArcana.interpretation: Not always the enemy, implications of rebirth and renewal, modern metaphor of organ donation - endings that allow new beginnings.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Hospital setting with faceless figure, scarabs (Egyptian rebirth symbol) crawling on clock

majorArcana.name: Art
majorArcana.interpretation: Taking opposing pieces, harmonizing them, combining into unique whole - 'Solve et coagula' (dissolve and combine).
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Mural on wall featuring Rider-Waite-Smith imagery, creative alchemy of old and new

majorArcana.name: The Devil
majorArcana.interpretation: Hedonism, fear, self-doubt, laziness keeping us in chains, addictions we should break but do not.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Dirty bathroom scribbles and stick figures, collaged textures for tangible feel

majorArcana.name: The Tower
majorArcana.interpretation: Things gone terribly wrong, crisis that forces change, structures crumbling to make way for new foundations.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Black and gold ornate tower in NYC, reflecting modern political crisis

majorArcana.name: The Star
majorArcana.interpretation: Dream just out of view but powerful enough to guide, pouring out love and kindness like water.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Bowery Mission (homeless shelter/soup kitchen), red doors and stained glass, city skyline at night

majorArcana.name: The Moon
majorArcana.interpretation: Journey into mystery and unknown, delving into things we'd prefer not to face, dreams and nightmares.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: NYC underground tunnels and sewers (Cobble Hill Tunnel), Anubis as psychopomp

majorArcana.name: The Sun
majorArcana.interpretation: Light that dispels confusion, childlike perspective that sweeps away complexities, enjoying simple things.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Union Square Park with Apollo statue, golden ratio proportions

majorArcana.name: The Aeon
majorArcana.interpretation: Looking at your place in history, judged by what we leave behind for generations to come.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Ellis Island and American Immigration Wall of Honor, Freedom Tower in background

majorArcana.name: The Universe
majorArcana.interpretation: Harmonious synthesis, at peace with universe and ourselves, comfortable knowing nothing yet eager for next journey.
majorArcana.urbanImagery: Chrysler Building eagle gargoyle, NYC skyline, International Space Station and Milky Way

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.interpretation: Raw potential energy, the fuel that drives spirit, making a stand for the better.
cards.urbanImagery: Statue of Liberty's torch overlaid with wand design

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.title: Dominion
cards.interpretation: Movement gaining traction, making sacrifices to reach goals, fire becoming focused tool.
cards.urbanImagery: Teddy Roosevelt equestrian statue outside American Museum of Natural History

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.title: Virtue
cards.interpretation: Movement united in defense of ideals, stronger when working together in harmony.
cards.urbanImagery: NYC Fire Department, 3rd Hook and Ladder company (9/11 first responders tribute)

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.title: Completion
cards.interpretation: End of job well done, achievement of greater understanding, road ahead is clear.
cards.urbanImagery: Columbia University graduates, Alma Mater sculpture at Low Library

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.title: Strife
cards.interpretation: Resistance encountered, competition can lead to growth, fighting to defend position.
cards.urbanImagery: Sports bar with baseball theme (Fenway Park, Yankee Stadium on TV screens)

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.title: Victory
cards.interpretation: Proven through sweat and blood, achieved real change, can rest on laurels or go farther.
cards.urbanImagery: NYC Marathon, Verrazano-Narrows Bridge, Ethiopian marathon winner

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.title: Valor
cards.interpretation: Voice of little guy with hopeless cause, spirit of righteous passion and moral courage.
cards.urbanImagery: Occupy Wall Street protests at Zuccotti Park, painted cardboard signs

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.title: Swiftness
cards.interpretation: Keep swimming to stay afloat, move forward before cause runs out of steam.
cards.urbanImagery: Bicycle delivery person, wand arrangement like bike wheel or NYC pizza pie

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.title: Fortitude
cards.interpretation: Determination and devotion to duty through sheer force of will, single fire burning stubbornly.
cards.urbanImagery: James Farley Post Office on 8th Avenue, mail push carts unique to NYC

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.title: Oppression
cards.interpretation: Idea that became institution, strength corrupted into cruelty, must consider if we've gone too far.
cards.urbanImagery: Depicts systemic racial bias in justice system, mass incarceration

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.title: The Rock Star
cards.interpretation: Pure passion, rebellion, idealism, charisma. Warrior, leader, blazing spark that burns fiercely.
cards.urbanImagery: Joey Ramone at CBGB, Johnny and Dee Dee Ramone on stage, Pegasus on drum kit

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.title: The Public Defender
cards.interpretation: Loving and compassionate yet fierce and protective, fighting passionately for the accused.
cards.urbanImagery: NY County Supreme Court, Triumph of Human Spirit Memorial fountain, leopard symbol

cards.name: Prince of Wands
cards.title: The Journalist
cards.interpretation: Fiery champion for moral change, uses words as weapons, satirizing those in power.
cards.urbanImagery: Broadcast graphics with stars and stripes, NYC skyline, news satirist style

cards.name: Princess of Wands
cards.title: The Dancer
cards.interpretation: Burlesque performer, seductive and enticing, full of lust and grace, pure joy of living.
cards.urbanImagery: Fire dance on stage at small club, NYC burlesque revival scene

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.interpretation: Chance encounter full of promise, infinite potential of love, first sight holding potential.
cards.urbanImagery: Bethesda Fountain in Central Park, Angel of the Waters sculpture, San Remo apartments

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.title: Love
cards.interpretation: Young love not yet tested, overwhelming infatuation, Romeo and Juliet moment.
cards.urbanImagery: Two strangers meeting at coffee shop (Green Lotus Coffee), hands touching mugs

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.title: Abundance
cards.interpretation: Honeymoon period, joy and fulfillment without limit, celebration and warmth.
cards.urbanImagery: Birthday party on New Year's Eve, toast in your honor, kiss at midnight

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.title: Luxury
cards.interpretation: Comfortable relationship past honeymoon phase, richness of love but lost sense of newness.
cards.urbanImagery: Couple watching TV together, comfortable silences, long-term relationship comfort

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.title: Disappointment
cards.interpretation: Perfect relationship crashing down, crushing lonely feeling, grief and betrayal.
cards.urbanImagery: Broken china hutch with raw steak (like open chest wound), shattered hopes

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.title: Pleasure
cards.interpretation: Perfect intimacy that deepens love, sexuality without guilt or shame, fertility and kindness.
cards.urbanImagery: Wedding night imagery, clean white silk sheets, emotional dimension of intimacy

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.title: Debauch
cards.interpretation: Allure of false and fleeting pleasure, self-destructive pursuit of thrills, hedonism.
cards.urbanImagery: Wild bachelorette party aftermath, fruity frozen drinks, drunken night castoffs

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.title: Indolence
cards.interpretation: Toxic morass of procrastination, depression, sloth, ever-deepening pit when someone stops caring.
cards.urbanImagery: Artist's own workstation, blank Photoshop canvas, laziness and self-recrimination

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.title: Happiness
cards.interpretation: Love reached full expression, all-encompassing fulfillment, happiness without fear or doubt.
cards.urbanImagery: Fort Washington Park, George Washington Bridge, summer family picnic scene

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.title: Satiety
cards.interpretation: Love's ultimate dream of home and family, joy and peace for the next generation.
cards.urbanImagery: Same-sex marriage celebration, homage to Pamela Colman Smith's original

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.title: The Seducer
cards.interpretation: Attractive and friendly but unpredictable, sudden passion may burn hot then be snuffed out.
cards.urbanImagery: Bar scene with crab (Cancer symbol), carousel horse tattoo, kitchen flames in background

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.title: The Therapist
cards.interpretation: Kind, affectionate, comforting, accepting without judgment, calm reflection and introspection.
cards.urbanImagery: Surrealistic office with koi pond, dreaminess of the suit

cards.name: Prince of Cups
cards.title: The Filmmaker
cards.interpretation: Master of emotional sea, calculated to produce specific effect, strives to touch something universal.
cards.urbanImagery: Film director scene, driven by need to evoke and charm

cards.name: Princess of Cups
cards.title: The Costume Designer
cards.interpretation: Kind and gentle dreamer, lover of romance and grand stories, transforms imaginary characters through clothing.
cards.urbanImagery: Broadway theatre district, basement costume studio, transforming dreams into reality

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.interpretation: The 'aha!' experience, sudden realization, moment of pure clarity with revolutionary potential.
cards.urbanImagery: Washington Square Arch, crown of intellect with shattered glass texture

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.title: Peace
cards.interpretation: Moment of perfect clarity, logic as clear as sunny day, all variables balanced.
cards.urbanImagery: Empty playground with seesaws, barbed wire fence, welcoming only in theory

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.title: Sorrow
cards.interpretation: Painful truths that cannot be ignored, nihilistic conclusions, knowledge leading to suffering.
cards.urbanImagery: References to loss, silent epidemic stealing our best and brightest

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.title: Truce
cards.interpretation: Diplomacy and negotiation replacing chaos, laying down swords to rest.
cards.urbanImagery: United Nations General Assembly Hall, forum for preventing global war

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.title: Defeat
cards.interpretation: Truce betrayed by self-interest, winning streak can't last forever, intellectual pride.
cards.urbanImagery: Video poker machine in darkened bar corner, thinking we can outsmart the house

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.title: Science
cards.interpretation: Triumph of intellect over ignorance, scientific method, peer review acceptance.
cards.urbanImagery: Rod of Asclepius (medical science symbol), hypothesis to conclusion journey

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.title: Futility
cards.interpretation: Bureaucracy grinding spirit down, tools of order creating inequality, can't beat the system.
cards.urbanImagery: Endless purgatory of bureaucracy, wheels of justice grinding powerless

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.title: Interference
cards.interpretation: Analysis paralysis, confused and unsure, caught in cycle of unlimited input.
cards.urbanImagery: Social media endless browsing, comments threads that never end

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.title: Cruelty
cards.interpretation: Most terrifying conclusions begin with noble goals, 'The End Justifies the Deed'.
cards.urbanImagery: Dictatorships beginning with order, weapons starting with peace

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.title: Ruin
cards.interpretation: Cost of endless analysis is loss of hope, hitting rock bottom with nowhere to go but up.
cards.urbanImagery: Hopelessness of addiction cycle, despair

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.title: The Game Master
cards.interpretation: Relishes debate and conflict, wields mind like blade, sharp analytical wit, dangerous opponent.
cards.urbanImagery: Every challenge like a game he's confident to win

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.title: The Painter
cards.interpretation: Keen observer with sharp creative intellect, creates because she must, art as mirror of truth.
cards.urbanImagery: Artist at drafting table, imagination floating free

cards.name: Prince of Swords
cards.title: The Hacker
cards.interpretation: Follows investigation no matter where it leads, information is everything, resourceful and determined.
cards.urbanImagery: Matrix-inspired, constantly churning out new solutions

cards.name: Princess of Swords
cards.title: The Activist
cards.interpretation: Environmental activist with bullhorn, warrior at heart with words as weapon, rooted in Earth.
cards.urbanImagery: Central Park activist handing out flyers, shouting slogans

disks.theme: Physical world, material wealth, body, growing things

cards.name: Ace of Disks
cards.interpretation: First step of new project, before something can be made it must be imagined, infinite variety of physical world.
cards.urbanImagery: Atlas sculpture at Rockefeller Center, Shorakkopoch boulder, Five Boroughs subway token design

cards.name: Two of Disks
cards.title: Change
cards.interpretation: Harmony of flow up and down, flexibility and deliberate choices, first prototype product.
cards.urbanImagery: Exercise and physical fitness, deliberate change in ourselves

cards.name: Three of Disks
cards.title: Works
cards.interpretation: Setting up storefront, talking to contractors, ready to open shop for first time.
cards.urbanImagery: Construction workers building new building on Broadway, city of impossible heights

cards.name: Four of Disks
cards.title: Power
cards.interpretation: Real success, paying employees, keeping lights on, newfound power and hope.
cards.urbanImagery: Times Square, commercial power on display, marketing and advertising influence

cards.name: Five of Disks
cards.title: Worry
cards.interpretation: Fear of loss, slow downward spiral, universal fear of mortality.
cards.urbanImagery: Doctor's office, diagnosis moment, shadow of Death outside door

cards.name: Six of Disks
cards.title: Success
cards.interpretation: Having enough to share, nobility, kindness to those who serve you.
cards.urbanImagery: Grand Central shoeshine station, Renaissance-era religious fresco tones

cards.name: Seven of Disks
cards.title: Failure
cards.theme: Failure as natural part of progress
cards.interpretation: Know that you may fail, but failure is not the end - get up, recover, learn, try again.
cards.urbanImagery: 2003 NYC blackout, Columbus Avenue lit by emergency road flares, city resilience

cards.name: Eight of Disks
cards.title: Prudence
cards.interpretation: Patience to give work time and space, wiser after falling and picking ourselves up.
cards.urbanImagery: Watch repair shop (Daniel Watch & Jewelry Repair on Lexington), patience with tiny gears

cards.name: Nine of Disks
cards.title: Gain
cards.interpretation: Secure place to enjoy fruits of labor, time to trust reins to others, early retirement.
cards.urbanImagery: King Spa in New Jersey, gold-plated pyramid sauna, luxury and relaxation

cards.name: Ten of Disks
cards.title: Wealth
cards.interpretation: Well-earned reward or warning that material gains can blind you to other things in life.
cards.urbanImagery: NYC Diamond Exchange on 47th Street, semi-cubist walk through bazaar

cards.name: Knight of Disks
cards.title: The Gourmet Chef
cards.interpretation: Craftsman never satisfied, always thinking how to make next creation better, no rest from work.
cards.urbanImagery: Head chef of own restaurant, dignified and proud of excellence

cards.name: Queen of Disks
cards.title: The Matriarch
cards.interpretation: Turns hot food into family dinner, house into home, strong and stable yet sensitive and caring.
cards.urbanImagery: Elegant Upper West Side dining room, family Seder setting, sunburst mirror

cards.name: Prince of Disks
cards.title: The Day Trader
cards.interpretation: Driven individual, pragmatic problem-solver, patient and unwavering, sees only opportunity in numbers.
cards.urbanImagery: Wall Street Bull desk sculpture, rolling office chairs, armillary sphere

cards.name: Princess of Disks
cards.title: The Kindergarten Teacher
cards.interpretation: Ultimate personification of elemental Earth, caretaker of growing things, protector of new life and beginnings.
cards.urbanImagery: P.S. 111 schoolyard on 10th Avenue, Hell's Kitchen graffiti mural, Worldwide Plaza building
